SELECT fished_date_season AS season,
       CAST(fished_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket,
       cls,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips,
       SUM(yt) AS total_yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0), 3) AS yt_per_angler
FROM trips
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT fished_date_doy AS doy, cls, COUNT(*) n, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) ang,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS yt_per_ang
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=1 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 335
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate ORDER BY avail_season, avail_doy

SELECT (SELECT MIN(fish_date_doy) FROM schedule WHERE avail_season=2 AND avail_doy = (SELECT MAX(avail_doy) FROM schedule WHERE avail_season=2)) AS earliest_offer_doy,
       (SELECT value FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=0 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_oni,
       (SELECT AVG(wtmp_c) FROM pier WHERE ts_season=2 AND ts_doy=(SELECT MAX(ts_doy) FROM pier WHERE ts_season=2)) AS latest_pier_wtmp_c
